description: This file contains functions and handlers for distributed nonlinear reduction operations such as argmin, argmax, min, and max within the PyTorch distributed tensor framework. It manages sharding, index conversions, and tensor gathering across device meshes.

methods.name: _get_output_sharding
methods.description: Retrieves the output sharding information for a given distributed operation call.

methods.name: _prep_arguments
methods.description: Prepares and normalizes arguments for nonlinear reduction operations, handling device mesh and placements.

methods.name: _get_expected_shape
methods.description: Calculates the expected output shape after reduction, considering keepdim and dim parameters.

methods.name: _collect_shard_mesh_dims
methods.description: Identifies mesh dimensions along which the tensor is sharded for reduction.

methods.name: _convert_to_global_idxs
methods.description: Converts local tensor indices to global indices based on device mesh and placements.

methods.name: _gather_tensors
methods.description: Gathers tensors and indices across sharded device groups for reduction operations.

methods.name: argminmax_handler
methods.description: Handles distributed argmin and argmax operations, performing index gathering and reduction.

methods.name: minmax_dim_handler
methods.description: Handles distributed min and max operations along specified dimensions, including gathering and reduction.
